Guidance & outlook: For Q1 FY27, our IaaS revenue was 51% of the total revenue, Managed Service revenue was 31.31%, and SaaS revenue was 17.55%.
So, I guess, we had recorded a revenue of around INR85 crores and a PAT of INR54 crores in FY26 versus almost a nil revenue for FY25.

FY27, we are targeting to conclude around INR1,500 crores of capex, and additional INR1,500 crores, whatever has happened, I exactly don't have the numbers in front of me right now, but we will be doing additional INR1,500 crores of capex in FY27.
Growth & demand: We also strengthened our product ecosystem with the launch of two new products: Swaraj Garuda for application performance monitoring and observability, and Swaraj Jatayoo for database activity monitoring.
Domestic business, we have got around INR3,000 crores of an order book with us.
And what are the -- see, you have stated the order book of local GPU is around INR1,000 crores.
Margins & costs: Our EBITDA stood at INR 559 million, translating to a healthy margin of 42%.
But now, with growth of AI factories, with growth of GPU business, we are seeing more numbers coming from Infrastructure-as-a-Service and better margins also coming from Infrastructure-as-a-Service.
We are targeting PAT margins in the range of 15% to 20%.
Capex & expansion: As the capacity keep on building up, we will initially prefer to offer all of that capacity to our international customers.
And we at the moment are not signing any customer to this capacity, reason being that the prices of GPUs are increasing in the month of Jan.
Our target is to block the capacity before the price goes up by 25% and then lease that capacity after the price goes up.
Balance sheet & cash: So, the new setup that we are doing in India is of a very small quantity, and that would be coming out of IPO proceeds and also some debt and some advance coming from the customers.
So, from the customer advance and the IPO proceeds, right… Customer advance, IPO proceed, and partial debt.
Risks & challenges: Thanking you Yours Faithfully For ESDS Software Solution Limited (Prasad Deochand Deokar) Company Secretary & Compliance Officer M.
PIYUSH SOMANI - CHAIRMAN AND MANAGING DIRECTOR - ESDS SOFTWARE SOLUTION LIMITED MR.
NADUKURU RAMAIAH - CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER - ESDS SOFTWARE SOLUTION LIMITED MR.
